elements.text: ROADMAP — Major Posteriors NOT in Current Model

Updated 2026-09-12 per R1+R2 review in mapreview.docx. Branch: wip/cloud-9-relhic. Current model: 4D joint posterior (log_σ/m_0, a, log_ε, log_α), 10 channels, log_Z = -2.94 (TIER-3 WEAKLY CONSISTENT). NOTE: 10^-54 means 10 to the -54 power.
Summary table — 7 missing posteriors, ranked (with reviewer priority bumps)
NEW: Phase 0 — Theoretical Assessment of ε Naturalness (1-2 weeks)

Per R1 (mapreview.docx Gap 1, paragraph 28): 'Adding m_χ and m_A' will not answer [the naturalness question]. Cross-channel correlations will not answer this. Baryonic feedback will not answer this. The naturalness problem is a model-building problem, not a fitting problem.'

Tasks: (1) Survey known suppression mechanisms (spontaneously broken U(1), clockwork, large extra dimensions, sequestering). (2) For each: can it produce ε ~ 10^-54 without new fine-tuning? (3) Decision: if ≥1 works → proceed with Phases 2-5; if NO mechanism works → pivot to Option B (publish null result).
Verdict softened (R1): TIER-3 RESOLVED → WEAKLY CONSISTENT
Per Reviewer 1 (roadmap1.docx, paragraph 11): log_Z = -2.94 corresponds to 'substantial' evidence on the Jeffreys scale, not 'strong'. The earlier verdict 'TIER-3 RESOLVED' was overclaiming.
Revised verdict: TIER-3 WEAKLY CONSISTENT with multi-channel data. The marginalization succeeds (log_Z = -2.94 vs catastrophic T30/T32), but the absolute evidence is weak per Jeffreys scale.
Three honest framings of the same posterior
1. Strongest claim: 'Tier-3 marginalization restores consistency with multi-channel data.'
2. Weakest claim: 'Tier-3 marginalization succeeds only if the mediator is decoupled from the Standard Model at the 10^-54 level — a naturalness catastrophe.'
3. Most honest claim: 'The model is consistent with data ONLY if the SIDM mediator is invisible to the Standard Model. That conditional is the entire result, not a caveat.'
STOP RULE — Do not add more channels (R2, paragraph 32)
Reviewer 2's critical warning: 'Do not expand the number of exotic channels (extra LRD variants, more UDG subtypes, etc.) until the naturalness issue is under better control.'

Channel 11 (DM-free UDG): pre-existing, KEEP. Channel 13 (DM-dominated UDG): added this session, KEEP. Any further channels (Ch14+) should be DEFERRED until: (1) ε naturalness addressed, (2) cross-channel correlations fixed, (3) m_χ + m_A' added.
Kill criteria per phase (NEW per R1 Gap 2)
Per R1 (paragraph 38): 'A credible scientific program needs a falsification threshold. ... A roadmap without a kill criterion is a plan to keep going regardless of what the data says.'

elements.text: Minimal alternatives (NEW per R2)

R2 (paragraph 120): 'Full hydro + SIDM comparison is a research-group-scale effort. A minimal one- or two-parameter nuisance (e.g., a simple core-size or feedback-efficiency parameter on the SPARC/UDG channels) is achievable faster and still addresses the fundamental degeneracy flagged by the reviewer.'
R2 (paragraph 133): 'Implement a minimal cross-channel correlation treatment — 1 week maximum. ... Do not let it become a multi-week blocker.'
Cross-channel correlations: 1 week minimal (R2) vs 1-2 weeks full (R1). Baryonic feedback: 1-2 weeks minimal (R2) vs 4-8 weeks full (R1). Recommended path: run minimal first.
Null result as legitimate outcome (R1, paragraphs 64-70)
Before Phase 2 begins, decide which outcome to pursue:
(A) Continue with Phase 2+: assume the model is worth pursuing (default)
(B) Pivot to publishing the null result: publish the naturalness catastrophe as the contribution
(C) Pivot to the symmetry question: investigate what symmetry could enforce ε ~ 10^-54
(D) Defer to particle-physics collaboration: hand off the ε problem to model-builders
Revised sequence (per R1 paragraph 73)
1. Phase 0 (theoretical, 1-2 weeks) — first, NEW
2. Phase 2 (correlations, 1-2 weeks) — prerequisite, not parallel
3. Phase 3 (baryonic feedback, 4-8 weeks or 1-2 minimal) — break SIDM/feedback degeneracy
4. Phase 4 (m_χ + m_A' jointly, 2-4 weeks) — only after Phases 0, 2, 3 complete
5. Phase 5 (mediator class, 2-4 weeks) — last
6. Phases 6-7 (defer indefinitely per R1) — these are refinements to a model that may not survive Phase 0
Quick stats
• Total estimated cost: ~3-6 months for particle-physics-grade model.
• Quickest impact: Phase 0 (1-2 weeks) + Phase 2 (1-2 weeks) = ~1 month of preparation.
• Highest risk: Phase 0 (no mechanism may work) → pivot to null result.
